ei.title: Hobbes: Mutual Fear, Not Affection, Binds Society
ei.subject: 10월_2024 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: Hobbes: Mutual Fear, Not Affection, Binds Society

fullPassage: According to Hobbes, man is not a being who can act morally in spite of his instinct to protect his existence in the state of nature. Hence, the only place where morality and moral liberty will begin to find an application begins in a place where a sovereign power, namely the state, emerges. Hobbes thus describes the state of nature as a circumstance in which man's life is "solitary, poor, nasty, brutish and short". It means when people live without a general power to control them all, they are indeed in a state of war. In other words, Hobbes, who accepted that human beings are not social and political beings in the state of nature, believes that without the power human beings in the state of nature are "antisocial and rational based on their selfishness". Moreover, since society is not a natural phenomenon and there is no natural force bringing people together, what will bring them together as a society is not mutual affection according to Hobbes. It is, rather, mutual fear of men's present and future that assembles them, since the cause of fear is a common drive among people in the state of nature.

questions.passage: According to Hobbes, man is not a being ①<u>who can act morally</u> in spite of his instinct to protect his existence in the state of nature. Hence, the only place where morality and moral liberty will begin to find an application begins in a place where a sovereign power, namely the state, emerges. Hobbes thus ②<u>describing</u> the state of nature as a circumstance ③<u>in which man's life is</u> "solitary, poor, nasty, brutish and short". It means when people live without a general power ④<u>to control them all</u>, they are indeed in a state of war. In other words, Hobbes, who accepted that human beings are not social and political beings in the state of nature, believes that without the power human beings in the state of nature are "antisocial and rational based on their selfishness". Moreover, since society is not a natural phenomenon and there is no natural force bringing people together, what will bring them together as a society is not mutual affection according to Hobbes. It is, rather, mutual fear of men's present and future that assembles them, since the cause of fear is a common drive among people in the state of nature.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② describing → describes: 이 문장의 주어는 Hobbes이고 뒤에 진짜 동사(정동사)가 있어야 한다. 분사 describing을 쓰면 동사가 없는 문장이 되어 틀림
det.analysis:
✅① who can act morally: 앞의 a being(존재)을 꾸미는 주격 관계대명사 who예요. '도덕적으로 행동할 수 있는'이라는 뜻으로 자연스러워요. (적절)

❌② describing(→describes): 'Hobbes thus ___ the state of nature as ...'는 홉스가 자연 상태를 묘사한다는 완전한 문장이에요. 문장에는 반드시 진짜 동사(정동사)가 하나 있어야 하는데, describing(분사)을 쓰면 동사가 사라져 불완전한 문장이 돼요. 그래서 describes로 써야 해요. 여기가 정답. (틀림)

✅③ in which man's life is: '~한 상황'을 나타내는 a circumstance를 꾸미는 부분이에요. '그 상황 안에서(in which) 인간의 삶이 ~이다'로 이어지는 「전치사 + 관계대명사」예요. (적절)

✅④ to control them all: 앞의 a general power(권력)를 꾸미는 to부정사예요. '그들 모두를 통제할 권력'이라는 뜻이에요. (적절)
det.tip: 문장의 진짜 동사 자리 → 분사(describing) 불가, 정동사 describes 필요

questions.passage: According to Hobbes, man is not a being who can act morally in spite of his instinct to protect his existence in the state of nature. Hence, the only place where morality and moral liberty ①<u>will begin to find</u> an application begins in a place where a sovereign power, namely the state, emerges. Hobbes thus ②<u>describes the state of nature as</u> a circumstance in which man's life is "solitary, poor, nasty, brutish and short". It means when people live without a general power to control them all, they are indeed in a state of war. In other words, Hobbes, who accepted that human beings are not social and political beings in the state of nature, ③<u>believe</u> that without the power human beings in the state of nature are "antisocial and rational based on their selfishness". Moreover, since society is not a natural phenomenon and there is no natural force bringing people together, what will bring them together as a society is not mutual affection according to Hobbes. It is, rather, mutual fear of men's present and future ④<u>that assembles them</u>, since the cause of fear is a common drive among people in the state of nature.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ believe → believes: 이 동사의 주어는 Hobbes(단수 사람 이름)이므로 단수동사 believes를 써야 한다. 중간에 긴 who절이 끼어 있어 헷갈리기 쉬움
det.analysis:
✅① will begin to find: 'begin + to부정사(~하기 시작하다)' 구조예요. '적용되기 시작할 것이다'라는 뜻으로 자연스러워요. (적절)

✅② describes the state of nature as: 'describe A as B(A를 B로 묘사하다)' 구조예요. 여기서는 as가 맞아요. (적절)

❌③ believe(→believes): 이 동사의 주어는 문장 맨 앞의 Hobbes예요. 사이에 'who accepted that ...'라는 긴 관계사절이 끼어 있어서 복수처럼 착각하기 쉽지만, 주어는 여전히 단수 Hobbes라 believes가 맞아요. 여기가 정답. (틀림)

✅④ that assembles them: 'It is ~ that ...' 강조구문의 that절이에요. 강조되는 말이 mutual fear(단수)라 단수동사 assembles가 맞아요. (적절)
det.tip: 주어 Hobbes(단수) → believes. 중간에 낀 who절에 속지 말 것

questions.passage: According to Hobbes, man is not a being who can act morally in spite of his instinct to protect his existence in the state of nature. Hence, the only place where morality and moral liberty ①<u>will begin to find</u> an application ②<u>begin</u> in a place where a sovereign power, namely the state, ③<u>emerges</u>. Hobbes thus describes the state of nature as a circumstance in which man's life is "solitary, poor, nasty, brutish and short". It means when people live without a general power to control them all, they are indeed in a state of war. In other words, Hobbes, who accepted that human beings are not social and political beings in the state of nature, believes that without the power human beings in the state of nature are "antisocial and rational based on their selfishness". Moreover, since society is not a natural phenomenon and there is no natural force bringing people together, what will bring them together as a society is not mutual affection according to Hobbes. It is, rather, mutual fear of men's present and future that assembles them, since ④<u>the cause of fear is a common drive</u> among people in the state of nature.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② begin → begins: 이 동사의 주어는 the only place(그 유일한 장소, 단수)이므로 단수동사 begins를 써야 한다. 바로 앞의 복수 명사에 속으면 안 됨
det.analysis:
✅① will begin to find: 'begin + to부정사(~하기 시작하다)' 구조로 자연스러워요. (적절)

❌② begin(→begins): 이 동사의 진짜 주어는 문장 앞부분의 the only place(그 유일한 장소)예요. 단수라서 begins가 맞아요. 바로 앞에 morality and moral liberty(복수)가 있어 복수동사 begin을 쓰고 싶어지지만, 그건 where절 안의 말일 뿐 주어가 아니에요. 여기가 정답. (틀림)

✅③ emerges: 주어 a sovereign power(주권 권력, 단수)에 맞는 단수동사예요. 사이에 'namely the state'가 끼어 있어도 주어는 단수예요. (적절)

✅④ the cause of fear is a common drive: 주어는 the cause(원인, 단수)라서 단수동사 is가 맞아요. of fear는 주어를 꾸미는 말일 뿐이에요. (적절)
det.tip: 긴 주어의 진짜 핵심(the only place, 단수) 찾기 → begins

questions.passage: According to Hobbes, man is not a being who can act morally in spite of his instinct to ①<u>protect</u> his existence in the state of nature. Hence, the only place where morality and moral liberty will begin to find an application begins in a place where a ②<u>sovereign</u> power, namely the state, emerges. Hobbes thus describes the state of nature as a circumstance in which man's life is "solitary, poor, nasty, brutish and short". It means when people live without a general power to control them all, they are indeed in a state of ③<u>peace</u>. In other words, Hobbes, who accepted that human beings are not social and political beings in the state of nature, believes that without the power human beings in the state of nature are "antisocial and rational based on their ④<u>selfishness</u>". Moreover, since society is not a natural phenomenon and there is no natural force bringing people together, what will bring them together as a society is not mutual affection according to Hobbes. It is, rather, mutual fear of men's present and future that assembles them, since the cause of fear is a common drive among people in the state of nature.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ peace → war: 통제할 공통의 권력이 없으면 사람들은 사실상 '전쟁(war)' 상태에 있다는 문맥이다. peace(평화)는 정반대라 부적절
det.analysis:
✅① protect: '(자기 존재를) 지키다'라는 뜻이에요. 자연 상태에서 존재를 지키려는 본능이라는 문맥에 맞아요. (적절)

✅② sovereign: '주권의, 최고 권력의'라는 뜻이에요. 도덕이 적용되기 시작하는 곳에 등장하는 주권 권력(=국가)이라는 문맥에 맞아요. (적절)

❌③ peace(→war): 앞에서 '통제할 일반적 권력 없이 살 때'라고 했으니, 그 결과는 무질서한 '전쟁(war)' 상태예요. '평화(peace)'는 정반대라 부적절해요. 여기가 정답. (부적절)

✅④ selfishness: '이기심'이라는 뜻이에요. 권력이 없으면 인간은 이기심에 근거해 반사회적이라는 문맥에 맞아요. (적절)
det.tip: 공통 권력이 없으면 → 전쟁 상태(war). peace(평화)는 정반대

questions.passage: According to Hobbes, man is not a being who can act morally in spite of his instinct to protect his ①<u>existence</u> in the state of nature. Hence, the only place where ②<u>morality</u> and moral liberty will begin to find an application begins in a place where a sovereign power, namely the state, emerges. Hobbes thus describes the state of nature as a circumstance in which man's life is "solitary, poor, nasty, brutish and short". It means when people live without a general power to control them all, they are indeed in a state of war. In other words, Hobbes, who accepted that human beings are not social and political beings in the state of nature, believes that without the power human beings in the state of nature are "③<u>antisocial</u> and rational based on their selfishness". Moreover, since society is not a natural phenomenon and there is no natural force bringing people together, what will bring them together as a society is not mutual affection according to Hobbes. It is, rather, mutual fear of men's present and future that ④<u>separates</u> them, since the cause of fear is a common drive among people in the state of nature.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ separates → assembles: 상호 두려움이 사람들을 '모은다(assembles)'는 문맥이다. separates(갈라놓다)는 정반대라 부적절
det.analysis:
✅① existence: '존재'라는 뜻이에요. 자기 존재를 지키려는 본능이라는 문맥에 맞아요. (적절)

✅② morality: '도덕(성)'이라는 뜻이에요. 도덕과 도덕적 자유가 적용되기 시작한다는 문맥에 맞아요. (적절)

✅③ antisocial: '반사회적인'이라는 뜻이에요. 권력이 없으면 인간이 반사회적이 된다는 문맥에 맞아요. (적절)

❌④ separates(→assembles): 이 글의 결론은 '상호 두려움'이 사람들을 하나로 '모은다(assembles)'는 거예요. '갈라놓다(separates)'는 정반대라 부적절해요. 여기가 정답. (부적절)
det.tip: 상호 두려움이 사람들을 모은다(assembles). separates(갈라놓다)는 정반대

questions.passage: According to Hobbes, man is not a being who can act morally in spite of his instinct to protect his existence in the state of nature. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① a sovereign power(주권 권력): 도덕이 적용되기 시작하는 곳은 주권 권력, 즉 국가가 등장하는 곳이다
det.analysis:
빈칸은 '도덕과 도덕적 자유가 적용되기 시작하는 곳은 ____, 즉 국가가 등장하는 곳이다'의 자리예요. 바로 뒤에 'namely the state(즉 국가)'라는 설명이 붙어 있으니, 빈칸은 '국가'와 같은 말인 최고 권력을 가리켜요.

✅① a sovereign power(주권 권력): '즉 국가'와 딱 이어져요. 정답.

❌② a natural phenomenon(자연적 현상): 뒤 문장에서 사회는 자연적 현상이 '아니다'라고 했으니 반대예요.

❌③ a mutual affection(상호 애정): 사람들을 묶는 것이 애정이 아니라고 한 글의 논지와 어긋나요.

❌④ a common drive(공통의 동인): 두려움의 성질을 설명하는 말일 뿐, '국가'와 같은 말이 아니에요.
det.tip: 빈칸 뒤 'namely the state(즉 국가)' → 빈칸 = 주권 권력(a sovereign power)

questions.passage: According to Hobbes, man is not a being who can act morally in spite of his instinct to protect his existence in the state of nature. questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ② in a state of war(전쟁 상태에): 통제할 공통의 권력 없이 살면 사람들은 사실상 전쟁 상태에 있다
det.analysis:
빈칸은 '통제할 일반적 권력 없이 사람들이 살 때, 그들은 사실상 ____'의 자리예요. 앞 문장에서 자연 상태의 삶을 '고독하고 가난하고 험악한' 것으로 묘사했으니, 권력이 없는 상태의 결과는 무질서한 다툼이에요.

✅② in a state of war(전쟁 상태에): 통제 권력이 없을 때의 결과로 딱 맞아요. 정답.

❌① in a state of peace(평화 상태에): 권력이 없으면 오히려 다툼이 생기므로 정반대예요.

❌③ under a sovereign power(주권 권력 아래): 지금은 '권력 없이' 사는 상황이라 어긋나요.

❌④ in mutual affection(상호 애정 속에): 사람들을 묶는 것이 애정이 아니라는 글의 논지와 반대예요.
det.tip: 통제 권력이 없으면(without a general power) → 전쟁 상태(in a state of war)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ③ 원문은 자연 상태의 삶을 '고독하고, 가난하고, 험악한' 것으로 묘사한다. '평화롭고 풍요롭다'는 정반대라 불일치
det.analysis:
✅① (일치) 'man is not a being who can act morally in spite of his instinct to protect his existence in the state of nature'와 같아요.

✅② (일치) 'morality and moral liberty will begin to find an application ... where a sovereign power, namely the state, emerges'와 같아요.

❌③ (불일치) 원문은 자연 상태의 삶을 'solitary, poor, nasty, brutish and short(고독하고 가난하고 험악하고 야만적이고 짧은)'라고 묘사했어요. '평화롭고 풍요롭다'는 정반대라 틀려요. 정답.

✅④ (일치) 'when people live without a general power to control them all, they are indeed in a state of war'와 같아요.
det.tip: solitary, poor, nasty(고독·가난·험악) ↔ '평화롭고 풍요'는 정반대

ch: 홉스는 인간이 자연 상태에서 자기 존재를 지키려는 본능에도 불구하고 도덕적으로 행동할 수 있는 존재는 아니라고 본다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

questions.passage: According to Hobbes, man is not a being who can act morally in spite of his instinct to protect his existence in the state of nature. Hence, the only place where morality and moral liberty will begin to find an application begins in a place where a sovereign power, namely the state, emerges. Hobbes thus describes the state of nature as a circumstance in which man's life is "solitary, poor, nasty, brutish and short". It means when people live without a general power to control them all, they are indeed in a state of war. In other words, Hobbes, who accepted that human beings are not social and political beings in the state of nature, believes that without the power human beings in the state of nature are "antisocial and rational based on their selfishness". Moreover, since society is not a natural phenomenon and there is no natural force bringing people together, what will bring them together as a society is not mutual affection according to Hobbes. It is, rather, mutual fear of men's present and future that assembles them, since the cause of fear is a common drive among people in the state of nature.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

✅③ (일치) 'Hobbes thus describes the state of nature as a circumstance'와 같아요.

❌④ (불일치) 원문은 도덕과 도덕적 자유가 'a sovereign power, namely the state(주권 권력, 즉 국가)'가 등장하는 곳에서 비로소 적용된다고 했어요. '국가와 무관하게 자연 상태에서 온전히 실현'은 정반대라 틀려요. 정답.

det.korean: ① 자연 상태에 있는 인간들 — 앞의 human beings in the state of nature를 받는다
det.analysis:
밑줄 their가 있는 부분은 'human beings in the state of nature are "antisocial and rational based on their selfishness"(자연 상태의 인간은 그들의 이기심에 근거해 반사회적이고 이성적이다)'예요. their는 바로 앞의 주어 human beings in the state of nature(자연 상태의 인간)를 대신 받는 말이에요.

det.korean: ③ a common drive(공통의 동인): 두려움의 원인은 자연 상태의 사람들 사이에서 공통된 동인이기 때문이다
det.analysis:

questions.stem:
다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록, [조건]에 주어진 단어를 모두 사용하여 영어로 쓰시오.

우리말: 인간은 도덕적으로 행동할 수 있는 존재가 아니다.

[조건] (1) a, act, being, can, is, man, morally, not, who 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 9단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: man is not a being who can act morally — '인간은 도덕적으로 행동할 수 있는 존재가 아니다'
det.analysis:
주어는 '인간'이에요 → man. '~이 아니다'는 is not이에요 → man is not.

무엇이 아니죠? '~할 수 있는 존재'예요. '존재'는 a being으로 놓고, 그 존재를 꾸미는 관계대명사 who를 붙여요 → a being who.

'도덕적으로 행동할 수 있는'은 can act morally로 이어요. '~할 수 있다'는 can, '행동하다'는 act, '도덕적으로'는 부사 morally예요 → can act morally.

완성: man is not a being who can act morally. (9단어)
det.tip: a being who + can act morally(존재를 꾸미는 관계대명사 who절)

③ 그래서 단수 주어에 맞춰 동사도 단수형 emerges를 써야 해요. emerge(복수형처럼 보이는 형태)는 틀려요. 정답은 emerges.
det.tip: 단수 주어 a sovereign power → 단수동사 emerges. 콤마 삽입구에 속지 말 것

questions.passage: According to Hobbes, man is not a being who can act morally __________ in the state of nature. Hence, the only place where morality and moral liberty will begin to find an application begins in a place where a sovereign power, namely the state, emerges. Hobbes thus describes the state of nature as a circumstance in which man's life is "solitary, poor, nasty, brutish and short". It means when people live without a general power to control them all, they are indeed in a state of war. In other words, Hobbes, who accepted that human beings are not social and political beings in the state of nature, believes that without the power human beings in the state of nature are "antisocial and rational based on their selfishness". Moreover, since society is not a natural phenomenon and there is no natural force bringing people together, what will bring them together as a society is not mutual affection according to Hobbes. It is, rather, mutual fear of men's present and future that assembles them, since the cause of fear is a common drive among people in the state of nature.

그 본능이 어떤 본능인지 꾸며 줘요. '지키려는'은 to부정사 to protect로 나타내요 → to protect.

무엇을 지키죠? '그의 존재'예요 → his existence.

det.korean: 정답: Hobbes thus describes the state of nature as a circumstance (홉스는 그리하여 자연 상태를 하나의 상황으로 묘사한다)

② 동사는 '묘사한다'인데, 주어 Hobbes가 단수라 describes로 써요 → describes.

③ 무엇을 묘사하죠? '자연 상태'예요 → the state of nature.

④ 핵심은 'describe A as B(A를 B로 묘사하다)' 구조예요. '하나의 상황으로'는 as a circumstance로 이어요 → as a circumstance.

전부 이으면 Hobbes thus describes the state of nature as a circumstance, 총 10단어예요.
